categories.main_business_segments: Syncmold Enterprise Corp. primarily operates in the design and manufacturing of LCD monitor bases, LCD TV bases, and AIO computer bases. The company also engages in plastic injection molding, mold design and manufacturing, aluminum and magnesium alloy die-casting, and precision stamping products. Its products serve mainly the electronics and display industries, focusing on high-structure strength and multi-axis rotation bases.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced mechanical design and manufacturing technologies including CNC machining, EDM, and automated production equipment. It specializes in four-link lifting structures, vertical lifting, multi-directional rotation mechanisms, and lightweight, thin, high-strength base designs. The mold manufacturing process integrates product design, mold making, sample production, and plastic injection molding with a focus on precision and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major international IT and electronics brands such as Dell, HP, Asus, Acer, AOC, Sony, and NEC, as well as system assembly manufacturers like AUO, Foxconn, Wistron, and Compal. The company serves the global LCD monitor, LCD TV, and AIO computer markets, with a significant presence in the gaming monitor segment, especially in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production facilities in Taiwan, China (including East China, Fujian, Guangdong, and Chongqing), and Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore). It serves global markets with a focus on Asia, North America, and Europe, aligning production close to key customers to enhance supply chain flexibility and service responsiveness.
categories.supply_chain_position: Syncmold operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing critical components such as monitor bases and molds. It sources raw materials like steel plates, aluminum and zinc alloys, and plastics from upstream suppliers and supplies finished components to downstream system assemblers and brand manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D in high-value-added products including advanced LCD monitor bases with multi-axis rotation, gaming monitor bases, and automotive-related precision components. It invests in automation to reduce labor dependency and improve production efficiency. Strategic acquisitions have expanded capabilities in precision bearings and magnesium alloy die-casting for emerging applications like foldable phones and automotive products.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of mechanical components and molds to international electronics manufacturers and system assemblers. The company offers integrated services from design to mass production, enhancing customer value and supporting stable order flows.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include leading display system assemblers and component manufacturers such as AUO, Foxconn, Wistron, Compal, and other specialized mold and component makers. Syncmold holds a leading position in high-end LCD monitor and TV base components, supported by extensive patents, strong R&D, and long-term customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$9.4 billion, a 7.24% increase from the previous year, with a gross margin improvement to 29.12%. Net profit and earnings per share also showed significant growth. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by market recovery and product mix optimization.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Syncmold differentiates itself through patented high-structure-strength and multi-axis rotation base designs, integrated one-stop services from design to mass production, and rapid delivery capabilities aligned with customer zero-inventory policies. Its global production footprint and automation investments enhance supply chain resilience and cost competitiveness, while strategic R&D and acquisitions enable entry into new high-value markets.
